**v1.14.6: fixes from a full review of the bot's code - no keys left held after an error, no clicks on the Crown buttons from traps, auras and prisms, F6 stops the walker at once, your learned cards can't be wiped by a failed save, Setup updates your install in place instead of starting a blank copy, and the vision helper keeps working when the card reader breaks after a game patch.**

- **Fixed: an error in the script left W/A/S/D held and the game sped up.**
  - **What was wrong:** when something unexpected went wrong in the bot's script, only the mouse lock was let go. W, the turn keys, the right mouse button (mouse steering) and the Cheat Engine speed stayed as they were, and the bot's main loop was gone while the bot still showed as on.
  - **Now:** an error lets go of every key and the mouse button and puts the speed back to 1x, then writes the error to debug.log; the error box still shows. The bot then shows as off (tray, dashboard, F6). Turning it on starts it again - it never starts again by itself, so an error that comes back can't repeat forever.
- **Fixed: trap, Feint, negative-aura and prism clicks could land on the Crown buttons.** The guard that keeps a target click off SHOP, UPGRADE NOW and EARN CROWNS (top left - enemy 1's name plate sits right there at UI scale 0.856) only covered hits and heals. Every target click goes through it now; when a click isn't safe, the card isn't cast and isn't counted as cast.
- **Fixed: the walker's X on the way to a goal, and at a talk goal, didn't look for Crowns on the prompt.** Every X looks first now. At a goal whose prompt shows Crowns the wizard waits by it with no X, and asks again a minute later.
- **Fixed: F6 didn't stop what the walker was doing.**
  - **What was wrong:** F6 turned the bot off, but the walker's step under way went on pressing W, turning, pressing X and clicking until it was done - seconds later. The walk to the potion seller and a dungeon run's turns went on the same way.
  - **Now:** every key and click of the walker, the potion walk and the dungeon steps checks that the bot is on. A potion run you start from the tray menu still goes on with the bot off. A potion run stopped by F6 isn't counted as a failed buy (which kept the bot from buying for 10 minutes).
- **Fixed: while the bot waited for mana, it swallowed what you typed in any program.** Your typing goes through now; only W/A/S/D in the game ends the wait, and with the bot off it doesn't watch the keys at all.
- **Fixed: an error box "Expected a Number but got an empty string" in a battle when the screen can't be captured** (a Remote Desktop session disconnected, say): a picture search that couldn't run kept an old "found" with no position.
- **Fixed: learned\cards.txt could be emptied.**
  - **What was wrong:** a save that failed (a full disk) still replaced the file, and a read that failed (an antivirus or sync tool holding it) was taken as an empty list and saved back over your cards.
  - **Now:** a failed write never replaces the file, and after a failed read the bot doesn't save its card list until it has read it. The same for learned\slots_written.txt, the walker's walk_memory.txt and its nav calibration.
- **Fixed: Setup refused every release folder** ("it has other things in it too (CheatEngine)"): its list of the bot's own files was missing CheatEngine, CheatEngine.ahk, GameRect.ahk and StreamView.ahk. A test now checks it against every file in a release.
- **Fixed: Setup run from a fresh download pointed your shortcuts at that blank copy.**
  - **What was wrong:** the Start menu entry, the desktop shortcut, the Run box, the "Open with Wizard101" watcher and the Cheat Engine script were all pointed at the download, so the bot you started every day had no learned cards and default settings (2026-11-21). Your real install was left where it was, unused.
  - **Now:** when your install is somewhere else (what your shortcuts start, and the bot has run there), Setup offers **Update your install in place**: this version is copied over it the way an update is, with its settings, learned cards and routes kept, and your shortcuts left on it. If the bot was started from the download after your install last ran, Setup asks whose settings and cards to keep - your install's unless you say otherwise; the other set is saved in its backups folder either way.
- **Fixed: the updater used the repository's old GitHub owner name.** It reached the bot's releases only through GitHub's redirect from a renamed account - a name anyone could register and publish their own "update" under. It uses Braehn/Wiz-Maxxing now: the update check, updating by itself, Setup's Version list, the token test and Report a bug.
- **Fixed: every 20 seconds the bot read the game's whole log to find your character** (WizardClient.log reaches 2 GB in a long session), stopping everything for seconds each time - a walking wizard ran on blind and F6 waited. Now it reads from the log's end, 256 MB at most a time and only what's new after that. The character found is kept for the next start on the same log (AutoFarmer\stats_char.ini).
- **Fixed: after a game patch broke the card names, the vision helper stopped reading the game's windows too.** When only the spell effect names can't be read (as after the 2026-11-26 patch), only the card kinds stop now; the login box, message boxes, backpack, decks, battle, gear and pet reads go on.
- **Fixed: web pages could send commands to the vision helper.** It listens on your PC (127.0.0.1) for the bot only, but a page open in your browser could quit it, change its network settings or overwrite picture files. Requests from web pages are refused now, and file names it's given must stay inside the bot's folders.
- **Fixed: two missed answers from the vision helper switched every game-memory feature off until the bot restarted** (and the log only mentioned cards). Now the helper is paused, asked again after 45 seconds, and restarted when it's gone or still stuck - at most 3 times in 30 minutes, never in the middle of a battle. The dashboard says "vision paused" meanwhile.
- **Also:** `test_ahk_names`' speedhack path test passes on Windows (it compared paths with / against \\).
- **Checked:** the fixes came from a full review of the code (180 confirmed findings; these are the 15 ranked first). Each fix was reviewed by two independent checks, and the whole change by two more rounds (six more problems found there and fixed). All 1163 vision tests pass (38 are skipped on this PC); the five release scripts load. Not yet seen in the game: installed on one PC on 2026-11-27 with the bot not started since.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install. Your settings, learned cards, routes and recorded battles are kept. The updater's new address takes effect once this version is in; the old one still reaches this release through GitHub's redirect. A copy run from the code: git pull.
